note: Specific checks for information conveyed through colour. A contrast-ratio test does not catch any of these: two colours can have ample contrast against the background and still be indistinguishable from each other.

values.label: Error, status or selection indicated by colour alone
Red/green or blue/purple pairs that are hard to distinguish
Chart series differing only by colour
Links distinguished from body text only by colour
Hover, focus, selected and active states
Patterns, labels, shapes or icons remain understandable without colour
